overview_description.description: Canix (YC S'19) has built the next generation of ERP software for cannabis companies. We provide tools to optimize day to day operations, stay compliant with state regulations, and make revenue-based business decisions. Leveraging cutting-edge tech and hardware, along with our rich dataset of pricing, yield, and inventory information, we are creating the technical foundations of the cannabis industry. Find out more at canix.com

about_short_description.short_description: Canix builds ERP software for cannabis companies

product.name: Inventory Management
product.description: Tracks cannabis and non-cannabis inventory through the supply chain with automated updates and essential reporting.

product.name: Compliance
product.description: Integrates with Metrc for automated, bi-directional data synchronization and validation to ensure regulatory compliance.

product.name: Invoicing & Purchase Orders
product.description: Generates and manages invoices and purchase orders for cannabis and non-cannabis inventory with multi-channel delivery and integration.

product.name: Live Inventory
product.description: Displays available cannabis products with a checkout and ordering system for bulk orders from distribution or retail partners.

product.name: Task Management
product.description: Tracks employee tasks and time estimates across the organization to support labor costing and productivity analysis.

product.name: RFID Integration
product.description: Uses RFID scanners and Bluetooth scale integration to accelerate harvesting processes by up to 75%.
